🎙️ 👔 Luciano Spalletti: “The disallowed goal? Well, the referee is a good official, although perhaps a little less good when it came to making the decision in that particular incident. “I don’t know the rules perfectly, but the way the incident unfolded certainly leaves room for interpretation. I was very disappointed when I watched it again in the locker room. “Lucumi made a mistake with his movement, but it wasn’t as though anyone had interfered with him. Considering that we should always encourage attacking football and the pursuit of goals, I felt the goal should have stood.” “Çelik felt some muscle tightness, but he’s a very alert player and recognised the problem.
